title: CLAIM and REFORMS report
summary: The CLAIM 2024 and REFORMS report every launched flow writes and checks at its end.
does: The end step of every launched flow (flows/stage.py) writes the run's CLAIM 2024 and REFORMS report from its records (tools/report.py) and checks that it is current; a run whose report is not current ends with a failed verdict. CLAIM is the checklist for reporting imaging AI, REFORMS the one for machine-learning science. It rides with every flow at no cost of its own.
